node.statement: For 0<=eta<=eta_A, node 1.1 supplies the extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra structure and the displayed maximum formula. Nodes 1.3.2 and 1.3.3 bound every entry of that maximum by C_A*eta, so epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta; this is exactly the root conclusion with the stated C_A and eta_A.
